fd_cost_q_o.formula: q_o = base_fee + rate_per_km * max(0, dist_km(pickup,delivery) - free_radius)

calibration_pass.note: Bo tham so DAU TIEN (theo thu tu quet base_fee tang dan, roi rate_per_km tang dan trong moi base_fee) dat ca 2 tieu chi Rq1.md Sec1.4: fd_rate in [0.10,0.50] VA khong supply-ratio cell nao GW/OD thang 0 tuyet doi. KHONG tiep tuc quet sau khi dat - dung dung tinh than khoa tham so.

alignment.formula: alignment(instance) = (1/|O|) * Sum_o 1[ min_k dist(pickup_o, corridor_k) <= r0 ]

r0_computation.method: percentile-25 cua toan bo pairwise (pickup, corridor OD) distance tren 1 pilot instance TRUNG LAP (KHONG dung lai cho main RQ1 grid)

control_params.corridor_share: instance_gen.generate_instance() optional kwarg moi, default None=0.7 (khong doi hanh vi goc)
control_params.corridor_buffer_km: instance_gen.generate_instance() optional kwarg moi, default None=3.0km (khong doi hanh vi goc); THEM SAU calibration 1D voi chi corridor_share khong du manh de phu target range (2026-09-16)

calibration_2d_grid.note: 42 to hop x 8 seed = 336 instance nho (chi sinh instance, khong chay DP)

0.10.deviation_note: [DEVIATION] KHONG dat duoc trong tolerance +-0.05. GIOI HAN CAU TRUC that: ngay ca corridor_share=0.0 (tat hoan toan corridor bias) cho alignment nen tu nhien ~0.27-0.53 (mean~0.36) vi khong gian nho (AREA_KM=8.0, da khoa truoc) + r0=1.3615km khien order ngau nhien van de roi gan >=1 corridor OD trong vai driver. Quyet dinh nguoi dung 2026-09-16: GIU target=0.10 trong grid, dung to hop gan nhat (mean=0.35), BAO CAO TRUNG THUC deviation nay trong moi phan tich RQ1 lien quan target=0.10 - khong loai bo target de 'lam dep' theo dung Rq1.md Sec3 dong 117-118.

0.30.deviation_note: [DEVIATION] |0.35-0.30|=0.05, dung nguong tol=0.05 (bien) - ghi nhan la deviation nhe theo dung tinh than 'khong am tham chon'.

fixed_generator_params_main_grid.note: Rq1.md Sec4 dong 129: 'giu nguyen default hien tai cua generator' cho tw_width/tau/capacity. tw_width KHONG co default that trong generate_instance() (tham so bat buoc) - dung 120, gia tri DA DUNG XUYEN SUOT moi calibration pass truoc cua RQ1 (q_o pilot, r0 pilot, alignment calibration curve). tau=30.0 KHONG phai default ham (default that=20.0) nhung CUNG la gia tri da dung nhat quan xuyen suot moi buoc calibration RQ1 truoc do - giu nguyen de nhat quan, khong quay ve default ham (se la thay doi am tham chua tung kiem tra).

b_gw_b_od.note: Rq1.md Sec4 dong 127 - khop gia tri dung o main experiment khac, khong mo them truc

seed_policy.note: Rq1.md Sec4 dong 131: '1 master seed/cell, sub-seed deterministic/replication'. Dung IG.stable_seed(*args) (SHA256-based, on dinh xuyen tien trinh) - cung ho ham da dung o run_2b_v2.py/rq1_calibration.py, khong tao co che seed rieng.
seed_policy.instance_seed_formula: gen_seed = stable_seed(n, B_gw, B_od, alignment_target, supply_ratio_gw, supply_ratio_od, replication_idx, 'rq1_main_grid')
seed_policy.theta_rng_seed_formula: theta_seed = stable_seed(n, B_gw, B_od, alignment_target, supply_ratio_gw, supply_ratio_od, replication_idx, 'rq1_main_grid_theta')
seed_policy.rationale: Tham so cell (n, B_gw, B_od, alignment_target, supply_ratio) + replication_idx xac dinh DUY NHAT 1 instance - doi tag ('rq1_main_grid' vs '..._theta') de RNG sinh geometry (order/driver location, time window) VA RNG sinh theta_i KHONG dung chung 1 stream (tranh tuong quan an gia giua vi tri va gia tri thoi gian rieng cua tai xe). corridor_share/corridor_buffer_km cho alignment_target lay tu bang locked_targets o tren (KHONG phai tham so seed - la tham so generator co dinh cho ca alignment level).
seed_policy.same_draw_across_5_treatments: CO - ca 5 treatment (JOINT, GW-ONLY, OD-ONLY, OD-FIRST, GW-FIRST) DUNG CHUNG 1 instance (cung order draw + driver draw + theta draw) cho 1 replication - Rq1.md Sec4 dong 130 'paired = cung order draw + driver draw dung cho ca 5 treatment'. Chi khac o TAP DRIVER duoc dua vao WDP (GW-ONLY loai OD, v.v.) - KHONG sinh lai instance rieng cho tung treatment.
